name: bos
description: Agent-first Business Operating System foundations for governed agent workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Agent-first Business Operating System foundations for governed agent workflows.
interface.longDescription: BOS is an agent-first Business Operating System for planning, implementing, reviewing, governing, and executing agent-ready business operations. BOS owns the authenticated MCP connection used by every installed BOS subservice. Education Center, CRM, Marketing Director, and other BOS-maintained plugins add domain workflows through a complete static operation catalog while BOS evaluates organization, installation, role, plugin, capability, provider, and tool authorization on every private operation.
defaultPrompt: List the BOS apps and skills installed for my organization.
Show me the tools and workflows available in each BOS app.
Check which BOS apps are connected and ready to use.
